name: com.tl.unity.ui
description: UI Toolkit for Tl timelines and ECS. A Tl UI Document next to the UI Document addresses elements with selectors and applies Show, Hide, Enable, Disable, class, attach, animate, text, signal and focus clips from com.tl.ui by Id, touching only what changed; clicks, value changes and hotkeys start UI timelines or send codes to game systems; Tl UI Data shows an ECS singleton written from Burst through UI Toolkit data binding, re-evaluated only when its bytes change. Zero managed allocation per frame once warm.

samples.description: One timeline drives every time block on one screen: Show, Hide, Disable, Add Class, Attach, Animate with hold (opacity and a progress bar), Text with reveal, a Signal and Focus. Tl UI > Samples > Build Basics, then Play. Builder and a PlayMode test that checks every block against its clip and measures the managed allocation of the UI code per frame.

A Burst ISystem writes an unmanaged HudData singleton every frame; a one-line Hud View (Tl UI Data) shows it through UI Toolkit bindings with the tl-integer, tl-clock and tl-visible converters. Heal sends a code to the game's UI Command Inbox, Flash plays an Also Plays timeline. Tl UI > Samples > Build Hud, then Play. Builder and a PlayMode test that checks every binding, both buttons and the managed allocation while the data changes every frame.

Lists, drag and nameplates. Bag slots come from an ECS buffer (Bag Rows, a Tl UI Buffer Rows) into a container: click uses an item, dragging a slot onto another swaps them, both through the game's UI Command Inbox. The shop is a ListView of ShopItem assets (Tl UI Asset Rows): click buys. Three wandering enemies get nameplates (Nameplate Views, a Tl UI Entity Views) that follow them on screen. Tl UI > Samples > Build Inventory, then Play. Builder and a PlayMode test.

Screen flow and settings with no screen C#: two screens are Tl timelines on one channel (End Hold), so TlPlay buttons swap them; the settings slider, toggle and dropdown bind TwoWay to an ECS singleton through a Tl UI Data view; Cancel (Escape, gamepad East) goes back; a P / gamepad Start hotkey pauses through a Burst system; Tl UI Tooltips. Tl UI > Samples > Build Menu, then Play. Builder and a PlayMode test.
